rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 8-Justice coalition together around a narrow, institutionally cautious ruling invalidating this geofence warrant as issued/executed while leaving room for more particularized reverse-location warrants. Expect Alito to dissent on workability and third-party/business-records grounds, with likely concurrences from Thomas and/or Gorsuch pressing a broader anti-general-warrant theory and from Sotomayor/Jackson emphasizing privacy and chilling-effects concerns.
